name: q-cleric
matrices_note: one list (parts[0]) loads each part's matrix from segment 0xD + part x 0xB8 + 0x38; the mod sets segment 0xD to the slot's part 0 node + parity x 0x40 (physical) before calling it and back to 0 after
offsets: from model.bin's byte 0 (the AKP1 header is bytes 0-63; base is where byte 0 was laid out)
pointers: physical (base - 0x80000000) in every G_VTX and G_SETTIMG; relocations lists their offsets

texture_pack.install: copy q-cleric-hd.rtz into the game's mods folder (a texture pack, switched in the Mods menu)

render_state: each list clears G_LIGHTING, and per texture group sets the texture LUT (G_TT_RGBA16 for CI4 tiles, with their palette loaded into TMEM 256; G_TT_NONE for RGBA16), loads its tile into TMEM (tile 7 load, tile 0 render), sets G_TEXTURE and the combiner (TEXEL0 x SHADE, or SHADE untextured). The mod sets, before the lists: 1-cycle, G_TP_PERSP, G_TC_FILT, G_TL_TILE, G_TD_CLAMP, G_CK_NONE, the texture filter the model was built for (see filter), a render mode or alpha compare for the 1-bit alpha, geometry G_SHADE | G_SHADING_SMOOTH on and G_TEXTURE_GEN off; and after them restores what the game had (lighting, texture LUT, texture state, combiner, TMEM contents)
warnings: --space model: part foot_l moved [2, -45, -1] units onto the game's joint (facing -z, or a very different build?)
--space model: part foot_r moved [-1, -45, -1] units onto the game's joint (facing -z, or a very different build?)
shin_l, shin_r, upperarm_l, upperarm_r: much thinner than the stock wrestlers', widened 1.8x (the most --width-fit does): check the pack in game
texture 0: the bake keeps 87% of its brightness (lift capped at 2.5)
texture 0 (1024x1024) has more than 16 colours: --quantize would keep more of it as CI4
texture 0 is 1024x1024: used as 32x32 (RGBA16 tiles: power-of-two sides, at most 2048 texels; TMEM is 4 KB)
